summary: Never replay a mutating request after an ambiguous failure, retry free media uploads with a size-scaled deadline, bound polls by the wait deadline and tolerate transient poll errors, treat a failed local download of a completed prediction as a recorded warning (not a failed generation) while keeping the prediction ID and output URLs, send JSON body pagination as numbers, and verify credentials in doctor with a /balance read.
reason: WaveSpeed bills per accepted prediction. The 4.18.1 client retried POST submissions up to three times on 5xx or dropped connections, a 2.5 MB PNG upload failed on a stalled socket with no retry, poll or CDN download failures after completion discarded the paid result in novel commands, and billings sent page as a JSON string so the API returned HTTP 400.
validated_outcome: Against the unpatched client, a prediction POST that hit a 504 or dropped connection was sent 4 times; the patched client sends it once. Live billings --agent returns HTTP 200 with numeric page. doctor reports verified credentials with the account balance.
upstream_issue: Generator already fixed body-param typing in v4.30.0 (#3867) and unsafe retries in v4.29.0 (#3615); upload retry and deadline scaling are not yet in the generator.
